app_not_found_body: This address does not exist in Portolab. Check the address again, or go back to the home page.

market_data_delay_notice: Prices are delayed by about {minutes} minutes and come from {source}. The latest price was recorded at {time} WIB.
market_data_empty_body: Portolab is fetching its first prices now. Reload this page in a moment to see them.
market_data_update_failed_notice: Portolab could not update the prices at {time} WIB, so it uses the last prices that it stored.
market_data_empty_failed_body: Portolab has no prices yet, because its latest attempt to fetch them at {time} WIB failed.
market_data_one_stale_price_notice: Portolab could not update the price of {codes} at {time} WIB, so it uses the last price of {codes} that it stored.
market_data_several_stale_prices_notice: Portolab could not update the prices of {codes} at {time} WIB, so it uses the last price of each that it stored.
market_data_one_missing_price_notice: Portolab has no price for {codes} yet, because its latest attempt to fetch it at {time} WIB failed.
market_data_several_missing_prices_notic: Portolab has no prices for {codes} yet, because its latest attempt to fetch them at {time} WIB failed.
market_data_no_price_notice: Portolab has no price for {code} yet.
market_data_simulation_body: The money in Portolab is virtual, so every result is a simulation. Every price is a delayed price from {source}, about {delay} behind IDX.
market_data_latest_price_notice: The latest price was quoted at {time} WIB.
measures_portfolio_link: See the value and the return of your portfolio
measures_method_notice: These measures are a simulation from past closes. Each monthly return is the change of the final close from the last trading day of one month to the last trading day of the next, without dividends. The measures of a stock or of a portfolio use the months, among the latest {window} complete months, in which the {index} and each of its stocks have a return, and they need at least {minimum}. Every value is per month.
measures_no_holdings_notice: You hold no shares yet, so your portfolio is cash alone, which earns no return in Portolab. Portolab computes the measures of your portfolio once a purchase of yours fills.
measures_one_unpriced_holding_notice: Portolab computes the measures of your portfolio once the next update of prices brings a delayed price of {codes}, because the weight of each stock is its value at its delayed price.
measures_several_unpriced_holdings_notic: Portolab computes the measures of your portfolio once the next update of prices brings the delayed prices of {codes}, because the weight of each stock is its value at its delayed price.
measures_months_notice: The measures below use {returns} from {first} to {last}.
measures_no_portfolio_variation_notice: The returns of the portfolio are the same in every month, so its variance and its standard deviation are zero, and a measure that divides by them has no value. Portolab computes such a measure once an order fills or an update of the price history gives the portfolio returns that differ from month to month.
measures_treynor_beta_not_positive_notic: The Treynor ratio divides the return above the risk-free rate by beta, so it needs a beta above zero, but the beta of the portfolio is {beta}. A beta of zero leaves the division undefined, and a beta below zero would turn a return below the risk-free rate into a reward for risk. Portolab computes the ratio once an order fills or an update of the price history gives the portfolio a beta above zero.
measures_above_line_notice: The expected return lies above the security market line, so it is higher than the return that CAPM requires for its beta.
measures_below_line_notice: The expected return lies below the security market line, so it is lower than the return that CAPM requires for its beta.
measures_on_line_notice: The expected return lies on the security market line within the rounding of its distance, so it matches the return that CAPM requires for its beta.
measures_bi_rate_notice: Portolab takes the BI-Rate as the risk-free rate. Bank Indonesia set the BI-Rate at {rate} on {date}, and that rate held at the end of the last month of the returns.
measures_bi_rate_link: The BI-Rate on the site of Bank Indonesia
measures_weights_notice: The weight of a stock is its value at the latest delayed price from {source}, about {minutes} minutes behind IDX, divided by the total value of your portfolio, and the weight of your cash is its share of that total. The page of your portfolio shows each delayed price and when it was quoted. Cash earns no return in Portolab, so it adds nothing to the expected return, the variance, or the beta.
measures_holdings_notice: The measures of your portfolio come from these measures of your stocks over the same months as the portfolio, which can be fewer than the months on the page of a stock.
measures_pairs_title: Covariances and correlations of your stocks
measures_pairs_notice: The covariance of a stock with itself is its variance, and a stock correlates perfectly with itself.
measures_risks_title: The risk that each of your stocks adds
measures_risks_notice: The share of the variance of a stock is its weight times its covariance with the portfolio, divided by the variance of the portfolio, so together the shares of the stocks make up the whole variance. A share above the weight means that the stock adds more of the risk of the portfolio than of its value.
measures_returns_notice: Each table lists the closes on the last trading day of the months and the return of each month that the measures use, so you can reproduce every measure in a spreadsheet with the functions that the formulas name. A close without a return is the start of the return in the row below it.
measures_stocks_notice: The table lists every stock of the LQ45 that Portolab records, so it covers every stock that you can buy or sell. Each stock uses the months in which it and the {index} have a return, and its page shows every formula and every return, or the whole reason why it has no measures yet.
measures_short_too_few_returns_notice: {count} of the {minimum} monthly returns that the measures need
measures_short_no_variation_notice: The returns of {code} are the same in every month
measures_short_no_risk_free_rate_notice: No BI-Rate is recorded on or before {date}
measures_stock_too_few_returns_notice: {code} and the {index} share {returns} in the latest {window} complete months, but Portolab computes the measures of a stock only from at least {minimum}.
measures_portfolio_too_few_returns_notic: Your stocks and the {index} share {returns} in the latest {window} complete months, and {code} has the fewest returns, but Portolab computes the measures of a portfolio only from at least {minimum}.
measures_stock_enough_returns_notice: If {code} and the {index} keep a close at the end of every month, Portolab computes the measures of {code} after the update of the price history that stores the close of the first trading day of {month}.
measures_portfolio_enough_returns_notice: If the {index} and each of your stocks keep a close at the end of every month, Portolab computes the measures of your portfolio after the update of the price history that stores the close of the first trading day of {month}.
measures_no_price_history_notice: Portolab has not stored a complete month of the price history of {instrument} yet, so it cannot tell when the measures come. It can tell once the next update of the price history stores that history.
measures_no_variation_notice: The returns of {code} are the same in every month of the measures, so their variance is zero, and a correlation with them would divide by zero. Portolab computes the measures after an update of the price history stores the close of a month that gives {code} another return.
measures_no_risk_free_rate_notice: Portolab has not recorded a BI-Rate on or before {date}, the end of the last month of the returns, so the measures have no risk-free rate. Tell your lecturer, so that the BI-Rate of that day can be added.
trading_missing_rules_error: Portolab cannot take this order yet, because it has not recorded the rules of IDX for the trading day of the order. Tell your lecturer, so that the rules can be added.
trading_missing_costs_error: Portolab cannot take this order yet, because it lacks a record of the broker fee or of the final tax on sales for the trading day of the order. Tell your lecturer, so that the missing rates can be added.
trading_missing_universe_error: Portolab cannot take this order yet, because it has not recorded which stocks are in the LQ45 on the trading day of the order, and Portolab lets you buy only the stocks of the LQ45. Tell your lecturer, so that the stocks can be added.
trading_no_price_error: Portolab has no price for {code} yet, so it cannot check the order. Try again after the next update of prices brings a price for {code}.
trading_outside_universe_error: {code} is not in the LQ45 on {date}, and Portolab lets you buy only the stocks of the LQ45 of the trading day. Choose a stock that is in the LQ45 on that day.
trading_too_few_returns_error: {code} has {returns}, but Portolab computes the measures of a portfolio only when each of its stocks has {minimum}. If {code} keeps a close at the end of every month and stays in the LQ45, you can buy it after the update of the price history that stores the close of the first trading day of {month}. Portolab must also have recorded the rules of IDX and which stocks are in the LQ45 for the day of the purchase.
trading_outside_limits_error: The field "{field}" holds "{value}", but IDX rejects that price for {code} on {date} by its auto rejection limits. They allow a price at most {upper} above and {lower} below the reference price of {reference}, and each end of the range is the nearest valid price inside those limits. IDX sets the reference price from the latest close of {code} before that day. Choose a price from {lowest} to {highest}.
trading_off_tick_error: The field "{field}" holds "{value}", but IDX accepts prices from {from} to below {to} only in steps of {tick}, the tick size of that range. Choose {below} or {above}, the nearest valid prices.
trading_off_tick_top_error: The field "{field}" holds "{value}", but IDX accepts prices of {from} and above only in steps of {tick}, the tick size of that range. Choose {below} or {above}, the nearest valid prices.
trading_purchase_cost_error: Buying {lots} of {code} at {price} costs {cost}, which is {value} for the shares and {fee} for the broker fee, but your available cash is {available}.
trading_one_purchase_sets_aside_cash_err: Your open buy order sets aside {setAside} of your cash of {cash}, and it returns that amount to your available cash if you cancel it or it ends without filling.
trading_several_purchases_set_aside_cash: Your {count} open buy orders set aside {setAside} of your cash of {cash}, and each returns its part to your available cash if you cancel it or it ends without filling.
trading_largest_purchase_error: The largest order that your available cash pays for at {price} is {lots}.
trading_highest_lot_price_error: Your available cash pays for {smallestOrder} of a stock only at a price of at most {highest}.
trading_below_minimum_price_error: Your available cash does not pay for {smallestOrder} of any stock, even at {minimum}, the lowest price that IDX accepts.
trading_price_rose_error: Portolab did not fill your market order to buy {lots} of {code}, because the price rose from {checkedPrice} to {price} while the order waited. At {price} the order costs {cost}, which is {value} for the shares and {fee} for the broker fee, but your available cash was {available}.
trading_sale_shares_error: This order sells {lots} of {code}, and you hold {held}.
trading_one_sale_sets_aside_shares_error: Your open sell order sets aside {setAside} of {code} until it fills, expires, or you cancel it.
trading_several_sales_set_aside_shares_e: Your {count} open sell orders set aside {setAside} of {code} until they fill, expire, or you cancel them.
trading_no_shares_error: This order sells {lots} of {code}, but you hold no shares of {code}, and you can sell only shares that you hold. Check the stock, and whether you meant to buy it.
trading_one_sale_frees_shares_error: You can sell more shares of {code} once you cancel that order or it expires.
trading_several_sales_free_shares_error: You can sell more shares of {code} once you cancel one of those orders or one of them expires.
trading_no_price_history_error: Portolab has not stored a complete month of the price history of {instrument} yet, so it cannot count whether {code} has the monthly returns that the measures of a portfolio need. Try again after the next update of the price history stores it.
trading_no_reference_close_error: IDX sets the range of prices of a limit order from the latest close of {code} before the trading day of the order, but Portolab has no final close of {code} for {date} yet. A limit order becomes possible once an update of the price history stores that close, if {code} traded on {date}, or once Portolab has a price of {code} from the trading day of the order. A market order needs no limit.
trading_lots_not_whole_error: The field "{field}" takes a whole number of lots, such as {example}, but it holds "{value}". Write the number in digits, with or without "{separator}" between groups of digits as the example shows.
trading_sell_for_cash_error: This order needs {shortfall} more than your available cash, and selling shares that you hold adds to that cash.
trading_one_sale_adds_cash_error: Your open sell order of {codes} brings cash when it fills.
trading_several_sales_add_cash_error: Your {count} open sell orders of {codes} bring cash when they fill.
app_empty_field_error: The field "{field}" is empty, but Portolab needs it. Fill it in.
app_not_text_error: The form sent a value of type {type} in the field "{field}" instead of text. Reload the page and fill in the form again.
app_too_long_error: The field "{field}" holds at most {maximum} characters, but it has {length}. Shorten it.
app_far_too_long_error: The field "{field}" has {length} characters, far more than any field of Portolab takes. Fill it in with the text that it asks for.
app_too_large_form_body: This form has {size}, but Portolab accepts a form of at most {maximum}. This happens when a very long text is pasted into a field. Open the form again and fill in each field with a shorter text.
app_too_large_unstated_form_body: This form has more than {maximum}, which is the most that Portolab accepts in a form. This happens when a very long text is pasted into a field. Open the form again and fill in each field with a shorter text.
accounts_forgot_password_notice: Forgot your password? A student asks the lecturer to reset it, and a lecturer asks the person who runs this Portolab server.
accounts_wrong_credentials_error: Portolab found no account with this username and password. Check both and try again. After {failures} wrong attempts within {minutes} minutes, Portolab blocks the username for a while. The block stops anyone who tries to guess the password.
accounts_username_blocked_error: Portolab blocks passwords for "{username}" until {time} WIB, because it received {failures} wrong passwords for it within {minutes} minutes. The block stops anyone who tries to guess the password. Try again after that time.
accounts_address_blocked_error: Portolab blocks passwords from your network until {time} WIB, because it received {failures} wrong passwords from it within {minutes} minutes. The block stops anyone who tries to guess passwords. Try again after that time.
accounts_first_setup_body: Welcome to Portolab. Give your name, choose your own password, and agree to the privacy notice to finish your account.
accounts_new_password_body: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
accounts_lecturer_name_hint: Your students see this name on each class that you teach.
accounts_student_name_hint: Your lecturer sees this name next to your work.
accounts_password_hint: At least {minimum} characters. A short sentence that only you know is long enough and easy to remember.
accounts_password_too_short_error: The field "{field}" needs at least {minimum} characters, but it has {length}. Each extra character makes a password much harder to guess, so choose a longer one, such as a short sentence.
accounts_passwords_differ_error: The field "{field}" differs from the new password. Type the same password in both fields.
accounts_consent_label: I agree to the privacy notice
accounts_consent_missing_error: Portolab stores your data only with your agreement. Read the privacy notice, then tick "{field}".
accounts_consented_notice: You agreed to the privacy notice on {time} WIB.
accounts_password_changed_notice: Portolab saved your new password and signed you out on every other device.
accounts_wrong_current_password_error: The password in the field "{field}" is wrong. Type it again. After {failures} wrong attempts within {minutes} minutes, Portolab blocks your username for a while. The block stops anyone who tries to guess the password.
accounts_refused_form_body: The form came from another site, or the browser did not say where it came from. Portolab refuses such a form, so that no other site can act in your name. Open Portolab directly and send the form again.
accounts_privacy_intro_body: Portolab is a simulation of portfolio management for classes. It stores only what a class needs, and it asks for your agreement before you start to use it.
accounts_privacy_username_body: Your username, which you sign in with.
accounts_privacy_name_body: Your name, so that the lecturer of a class knows whose work it sees, and so that students know who teaches their class.
accounts_privacy_password_body: Your password, only as a hash that cannot be turned back into the password.
accounts_privacy_classes_body: The classes that you teach or joined, and your simulated work in each class that you joined: your cash, your holdings, and your orders, with the reason that you write for an order.
accounts_privacy_consent_body: The time when you agreed to this notice.
accounts_privacy_session_body: For each device where you are signed in, a cookie that keeps you signed in. Portolab stores only a hash of it, and the session ends after {days} days without a visit.
accounts_privacy_address_body: The address of your network, in memory only, for {minutes} minutes after each wrong password, wrong code of a class, or request for a new account from it, to stop anyone from guessing passwords and codes or from flooding a class with accounts.
accounts_privacy_language_body: A cookie with the language that you chose, which stays in your browser.
accounts_privacy_last_class_body: A cookie with the class that you opened last, which your browser keeps for {days} days, so that Portolab opens that class when you come back.
accounts_privacy_not_stored_body: Portolab stores no email address, no phone number, and nothing about your real finances. It uses no tracking and no advertising, and it gives your data to no one.
accounts_privacy_lecturer_body: The lecturer of a class sees the name, the username, and the work of each student in it, and can download them in a spreadsheet for grading. The lecturer also reads the reason that a student writes for an order. Students do not see the data of other students.
accounts_privacy_server_body: The person who runs this Portolab server can read everything that it stores, because they keep its database.
accounts_privacy_rights_body: Indonesia's Law Number 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection gives you the right to see, correct, and delete your data, and to withdraw your agreement. You can change your name on the page of your account. Portolab keeps your data until the person who runs this server deletes it, so ask them for a copy of all your data or for its deletion. To withdraw your agreement, ask them to delete your data, because Portolab stores your data only with your agreement.
accounts_sign_out_body: Sign out of Portolab on this device.
accounts_username_hint: You sign in with it. It has {minimum} to {maximum} characters from {characters}.
accounts_username_error: The field "{field}" takes {minimum} to {maximum} characters from {characters}, but it holds "{value}". Choose a username, such as budi.santoso.
home_join_link: Join a class with its code
classes_no_taught_classes_body: You teach no class yet. Create one below, then share its code with your students.
classes_no_joined_classes_body: You are in no class. Join one with the code that your lecturer gave you.
classes_join_link: Join a class with its code
classes_starting_cash_hint: The virtual cash in whole rupiah that each student starts with.
classes_starting_cash_error: The field "{field}" takes a whole number of rupiah, such as {example}, but it holds "{value}". Write the amount in digits, with or without "{separator}" between groups of digits as the example shows.
classes_starting_cash_range_error: The field "{field}" takes {minimum} to {maximum}, but it holds "{value}". Less cash buys too few lots for a portfolio, and the maximum keeps every sum in a class exact. Choose an amount between the two.
classes_share_notice: Share the code or the address with your students. Each student who joins starts with {cash} in virtual cash.
classes_local_network_notice: You opened Portolab at "{host}", which only this computer can open. So the address for joining leads to this computer on its network, which phones on the same Wi-Fi network can open. When a phone cannot open it, the firewall of this computer or the Wi-Fi network blocks the connection. Allow the connection in the firewall, or use a network that lets devices reach each other, such as the hotspot of a phone.
classes_several_networks_notice: This computer is on several networks, so the page shows the address on each, under the name of its connection. Give your students the address on the network that their phones use.
classes_no_network_notice: Phones cannot open Portolab yet, because you opened it at "{host}", which only this computer can open, and this computer is on no network. Connect it to the Wi-Fi network of the class, then reload this page for the address that your students join with. Each student who joins starts with {cash} in virtual cash.
classes_student_notice: Signs in as "{username}". Joined on {time} WIB.
classes_joined_notice: You joined this class on {time} WIB.
classes_starting_cash_notice: You start with {cash} in virtual cash.
classes_reset_body: Portolab gives {name}, who signs in as "{username}", a temporary password and signs them out on every device. At the next sign-in, they choose a new password.
classes_temporary_password_notice: Give {name} this temporary password. It works until they choose a new one.
classes_join_body: Enter the code that your lecturer gave you.
classes_malformed_code_error: The field "{field}" takes the code of a class, which has {length} letters and digits without {lookalikes}, but it holds "{code}". Check the code with your lecturer.
classes_unknown_code_error: The field "{field}" holds "{code}", but no class has this code. Check the code with your lecturer and try again.
classes_join_blocked_error: Portolab blocks codes from your network until {time} WIB, because it received {failures} wrong codes from it within {minutes} minutes. The block stops anyone who tries to guess the code of a class. Try again after that time.
classes_lecturer_join_error: Only students join a class, and you are signed in as a lecturer. To join as a student, sign out first.
classes_lecturer_join_title: A lecturer cannot join a class
classes_join_class_body: {lecturer} teaches this class. Each student starts with {cash} in virtual cash.
classes_existing_account_link: Sign in with the account that you have
classes_username_taken_error: The field "{field}" holds "{username}", but another account has this username. Choose another one, such as this username with a number at its end.
accounts_privacy_attempts_body: A username that someone typed with a wrong password, in memory only, for {minutes} minutes after each wrong password for it, to stop anyone from guessing the password of an account.
trading_lots_too_many_error: The field "{field}" takes at most {maximum}, the largest order that IDX accepts, but it holds "{value}". Choose at most {maximum}, and trade more lots in further orders.
trading_lots_too_few_error: The field "{field}" needs at least {minimum}, the smallest order, but it holds "{value}". Choose at least {minimum}.
trading_new_order_error: Place a new order if you still want {code}, and Portolab checks it at the price and with the cash of that moment.
classes_new_accounts_blocked_error: Portolab creates no account from your network until {time} WIB, because it received {accounts} requests for a new account from it within {minutes} minutes. The limit stops anyone who tries to flood a class with accounts. Try again after that time, or join through another network, such as the mobile data of your phone.
classes_lecturer_only_error: Only lecturers create a class, and you are signed in as a student. To teach a class, ask the person who runs this Portolab server for a lecturer account.
classes_lecturer_only_title: A student cannot create a class
classes_first_session_hint: The later sessions meet each week after it, until session {count}. Portolab finds the semester of this class from this date.
classes_no_first_session_error: The field "{field}" holds no complete date yet. Fill it in with the day, the month, and the year of session 1, because Portolab counts the session of each week from that date.
classes_not_date_error: The form sent "{value}" in the field "{field}" instead of a date. Reload the page and fill in the form again.
classes_first_session_range_error: The field "{field}" takes {earliest} to {latest}, but it holds "{value}". A class runs in the current semester or a near one, so Portolab takes a date of session 1 at most {days} days before or after today. Check the year of the date.
classes_course_ahead_notice: The course of this class starts with session {session}, "{title}", on {date}.
classes_course_session_notice: The session of this week is session {session} of {count}, "{title}", on {date}.
classes_course_over_notice: The course of this class ended with session {session}, "{title}", on {date}.
classes_lecturer_no_calendar_notice: Portolab does not know the date of session 1 of this class yet, so it cannot show you and your students the session of each week.
classes_student_no_calendar_notice: Your lecturer has not set the date of session 1 of this class yet. Portolab shows the session of each week once your lecturer sets it.
classes_midterm_exam_session_title: Midterm exam and the final research proposal
classes_capm_session_title: CAPM and the security market line

trading_shares_gone_error: Portolab did not fill your order to sell {lots} of {code}, because when a price reached it, you held {held} of {code}.
trading_fill_notice: Portolab fills an order at a delayed price from {source}, about {minutes} minutes behind IDX, that was quoted in session I or session II of the trading day of the order. So a fill can differ from the price on the exchange at the same moment.
trading_one_sale_sets_aside_notice: Your open sell order sets aside {shares} of this holding.
trading_several_sales_set_aside_notice: Your {count} open sell orders set aside {shares} of this holding.
trading_day_notice: An order that you place now can fill at a delayed price quoted in session I or session II on {date}, from {start} WIB, and it expires at {end} WIB if it has not filled by then.
trading_stock_hint: You can buy a stock of the LQ45 that has the monthly returns that the measures of a portfolio need, and sell a stock that you hold.
trading_no_price_order_notice: You can place an order of {code} once the next update of prices brings a delayed price of {code}.
trading_lots_hint: A lot is {shares}. An order has {smallest} to {largest}, the largest order that IDX accepts.
trading_limit_price_hint: In whole rupiah. Only a limit order uses it. A purchase fills at this price or lower, and a sale at this price or higher.
trading_reason_hint: Why you place this order, in at most {maximum} characters. Portolab keeps it with the order, and the lecturer of this class can read it.
trading_placed_notice: Portolab accepted your order, and your orders below show where it stands.
trading_no_stock_error: The field "{field}" holds no stock yet. Choose the stock of the order.
trading_unknown_stock_error: The address of this page names "{value}" as the stock, but Portolab trades only the stocks in the list of the field "{field}". Choose one of them.
trading_no_choice_error: The field "{field}" holds no choice yet. Choose {choices}.
trading_unknown_choice_error: The form sent "{value}" in the field "{field}", but the field takes only {choices}. Reload the page and choose one of them.
trading_limit_not_whole_error: The field "{field}" takes a price in whole rupiah, such as {example}, but it holds "{value}". Write the price in digits, with or without "{separator}" between groups of digits as the example shows.
trading_no_past_orders_body: None of your orders has ended yet.
trading_market_purchase_title: Buy {lots} of {code} at the market price
trading_limit_purchase_title: Buy {lots} of {code} at a limit of {limit}
trading_market_sale_title: Sell {lots} of {code} at the market price
trading_limit_sale_title: Sell {lots} of {code} at a limit of {limit}
trading_placed_at_notice: Placed on {time} WIB for the trading day {date}.
trading_waiting_notice: It waits for a delayed price of {code} from session I or session II.
trading_resting_notice: It rests at its limit, because the delayed prices of its sessions have not reached the limit yet. It fills at its limit once a price reaches it.
trading_purchase_sets_aside_notice: It sets aside {cash} of your cash.
trading_expires_notice: It expires at {time} WIB if it has not filled by then.
trading_purchase_filled_notice: Filled at {price}, a delayed price quoted on {time} WIB. It cost {cost}, which is {value} for the shares and {fee} for the broker fee.
trading_sale_filled_notice: Filled at {price}, a delayed price quoted on {time} WIB. It brought {proceeds}, which is {value} for the shares less {fee} for the broker fee and {tax} for the final tax on sales.
trading_expired_notice: It expired without filling when the delayed prices of {date} became final at {time} WIB.
trading_rejected_notice: Rejected on {time} WIB, at a delayed price quoted on {quotedTime} WIB.
trading_order_ended_error: Your order of {lots} of {code} placed on {time} WIB is no longer open, so Portolab cannot cancel it. Your past orders below show how it ended.
trading_missing_order_error: Portolab holds no such order among your orders, so it cancelled nothing. The list below shows each open order that you can cancel.
classes_measures_link: Return and risk of your portfolio and of each stock
trading_one_other_sale_set_aside_error: Your other open sell order set aside {setAside} of {code} then.
trading_several_other_sales_set_aside_er: Your {count} other open sell orders set aside {setAside} of {code} then.
trading_check_holdings_error: Check the shares that you hold now in your holdings above before you sell again.
trading_rules_missing_notice: Portolab cannot take an order now, because it has not recorded the rules of IDX for the trading day of an order that you place now. Tell your lecturer, so that the rules can be added.
trading_costs_missing_notice: Portolab cannot take an order now, because it lacks a record of the broker fee or of the final tax on sales for the trading day of an order that you place now. Tell your lecturer, so that the missing rates can be added.
trading_measures_link: See the return and the risk of your portfolio and of each stock
trading_valuation_notice: Your portfolio is a simulation with virtual cash. Portolab values each holding at the latest delayed price from {source}, about {minutes} minutes behind IDX, so a value can differ from the value on the exchange at the same moment.
trading_one_unpriced_holding_notice: Portolab shows the total value and the return once the next update of prices brings a delayed price of {codes}.
trading_several_unpriced_holdings_notice: Portolab shows the total value and the return once the next update of prices brings the delayed prices of {codes}.
trading_unpriced_notice: Portolab has no delayed price of {code} yet.
trading_chart_notice: The chart and the table below compare the return of your portfolio with the return of the {index} since the close of {date}, before you could trade. Each of their returns uses the final closes of its day.
trading_chart_not_final_notice: The prices of {date} become final at {time} WIB, and Portolab shows the returns from that day on once an update of the price history stores closes of that day or of a later day.
trading_one_missing_close_notice: Portolab has not stored the close of {codes} on {date} yet. It shows the returns from that day on once an update of the price history stores a close of {codes} on that day or on a later day.
trading_several_missing_closes_notice: Portolab has not stored the closes of {codes} on {date} yet. It shows the returns from that day on once an update of the price history stores a close of each of them on that day or on a later day.
trading_chart_calendar_missing_notice: Portolab cannot show the return of the next trading day, because it has not recorded the trading calendar of IDX for that day. Tell your lecturer, so that the calendar can be added.
classes_portfolios_link: Portfolios and measures of the students
trading_lecturer_valuation_notice: The portfolio of {name} is a simulation with virtual cash. Portolab values each holding at the latest delayed price from {source}, about {minutes} minutes behind IDX, so a value can differ from the value on the exchange at the same moment.
trading_lecturer_no_reasons_body: {name} has not written a reason for any order yet.
trading_lecturer_chart_notice: The chart and the table below compare the return of the portfolio of {name} with the return of the {index} since the close of {date}, before {name} could trade. Each of their returns uses the final closes of its day.
trading_lecturer_chart_calendar_missing_: Portolab cannot show the return of the next trading day, because it has not recorded the trading calendar of IDX for that day. Tell the person who runs this Portolab server, so that the calendar can be added.
measures_lecturer_no_holdings_notice: {name} holds no shares yet, so the portfolio is cash alone, which earns no return in Portolab. Portolab computes the measures of the portfolio once a purchase of {name} fills.
measures_lecturer_one_unpriced_holding_n: Portolab values the portfolio of {name} and computes its measures once the next update of prices brings a delayed price of {codes}, because the value and the weight of each stock come from its delayed price.
measures_lecturer_several_unpriced_holdi: Portolab values the portfolio of {name} and computes its measures once the next update of prices brings the delayed prices of {codes}, because the value and the weight of each stock come from its delayed price.
measures_lecturer_weights_notice: The weight of a stock is its value at the latest delayed price from {source}, about {minutes} minutes behind IDX, divided by the total value of the portfolio, and the weight of the cash is its share of that total. The page of the portfolio of {name} shows each delayed price and when it was quoted. Cash earns no return in Portolab, so it adds nothing to the expected return, the variance, or the beta.
measures_lecturer_holdings_title: The stocks of the portfolio in these months
measures_lecturer_holdings_notice: The measures of the portfolio come from these measures of its stocks over the same months as the portfolio, which can be fewer than the months that the measures of a stock alone use.
measures_lecturer_pairs_title: Covariances and correlations of the stocks of the portfolio
measures_lecturer_risks_title: The risk that each stock of the portfolio adds
measures_lecturer_too_few_returns_notice: The stocks of {name} and the {index} share {returns} in the latest {window} complete months, and {code} has the fewest returns, but Portolab computes the measures of a portfolio only from at least {minimum}.
measures_lecturer_enough_returns_notice: If the {index} and each stock of {name} keep a close at the end of every month, Portolab computes the measures of the portfolio of {name} after the update of the price history that stores the close of the first trading day of {month}.
measures_lecturer_no_risk_free_rate_noti: Portolab has not recorded a BI-Rate on or before {date}, the end of the last month of the returns, so the measures have no risk-free rate. Tell the person who runs this Portolab server, so that the BI-Rate of that day can be added.
measures_portfolio_line_notice: The chart places your portfolio, your stocks, and every other stock whose measures use the same months as your portfolio against the security market line of those months, which give {returns} from {first} to {last}.
measures_lecturer_portfolio_line_notice: The chart places the portfolio of {name} and its stocks against the security market line of the months of its measures, which give {returns} from {first} to {last}.
measures_latest_line_notice: Your portfolio has no measures yet, so the chart places every stock whose measures use the latest complete months of the {index} against the security market line of those months, which give {returns} from {first} to {last}.
measures_line_notice: The line runs through the risk-free rate at a beta of 0 and the expected return of the {index} at a beta of 1, so it gives the return that CAPM requires for each beta. A point above the line has a higher expected return than CAPM requires for its beta, and a point below it has a lower one.
measures_map_vertical_notice: Vertical: the expected return per month.
measures_lecturer_line_holdings_label: Stocks of the portfolio, size = weight
measures_one_other_line_notice: {codes} is not on the chart, because its measures use different months, which give a different security market line. Its page shows its distance from that line.
measures_several_other_lines_notice: {codes} are not on the chart, because their measures use different months, which give different security market lines. The page of each of them shows its distance from its own line.
measures_unmeasured_stocks_notice: A stock that has no measures yet is not on the chart, and the table of the measures of each stock below says why.
measures_line_too_few_returns_notice: The {index} has {returns} in the latest {window} complete months, but Portolab computes the security market line only from at least {minimum}.
measures_line_enough_returns_notice: If the {index} keeps a close at the end of every month, Portolab computes the line after the update of the price history that stores the close of the first trading day of {month}.
measures_beta_concept_body: Beta measures how strongly returns move with the {index}.
measures_risk_concept_body: Standard deviation measures how far monthly returns vary from their average.
measures_return_concept_body: Portolab uses the average past monthly return as an estimate of future returns.
measures_sharpe_concept_body: The Sharpe ratio divides the return above the risk-free rate by the standard deviation of the portfolio.
measures_treynor_concept_body: The Treynor ratio divides the return above the risk-free rate by the beta of the portfolio.
measures_alpha_concept_body: Jensen's alpha is the difference between the expected return and the return that CAPM requires for the same beta.
measures_risk_free_concept_body: Portolab uses the BI-Rate as the risk-free rate and converts it to a monthly rate.
measures_market_concept_body: The {index} measures stock movements on IDX, and Portolab uses it as the market portfolio.
grading_valuation_notice: Each portfolio is a simulation with virtual cash. Portolab values each holding at the latest delayed price from {source}, about {minutes} minutes behind IDX. The page of the portfolio of each student shows each delayed price, when it was quoted, and the prices that the latest update could not fetch.
grading_export_link: Download the portfolios as a spreadsheet
grading_export_notice: The spreadsheet is an Excel workbook with the values and the measures of this page, in the same order. Excel, Google Sheets, and LibreOffice open it, and each writes its numbers in the format of its own language.
grading_ranked_notice: Portolab ranks these portfolios by Jensen's alpha, the distance of their expected return from the security market line, from the highest to the lowest. The distance compares the expected return with the return that CAPM requires for the beta of the portfolio, so the rank rewards the return for the risk that a portfolio takes, not the return alone.
grading_no_ranked_body: No portfolio of this class has measures yet, so Portolab ranks none. Each portfolio below says why it has none.
grading_no_students_body: No student has joined this class yet, so there is no portfolio to show.
grading_measures_link: Return and risk of the portfolio of {name}
grading_all_portfolios_link: Back to the portfolios of the students in {class}
grading_workbook_notice: A simulation with virtual cash, downloaded on {time} WIB. Portolab valued each holding at the latest delayed price from {source}, about {minutes} minutes behind IDX. Every measure is per month, and the portfolios with measures come first, from the highest Jensen's alpha to the lowest.
grading_reason_label: Why the portfolio has no measures
app_concept_lesson_notice: Learn more in session {session}. The lesson is not available in Portolab yet.
trading_rejected_title: Portolab did not accept this order
trading_quote_notice: Delayed by about {minutes} minutes, quoted at {time} WIB.
market_data_no_closes_notice: There are no closing prices in this range yet. Check again when a price history update stores closes in this range.
market_data_year_range_body: The lowest and highest stored closes within {weeks} weeks, adjusted for stock splits, with the mark on the latest stored close.
market_data_year_range_notice: Stored closes from {first} to {last} range from {low} to {high} rupiah per share.
measures_portfolio_correlation_body: Correlation measures how stock and portfolio returns move together over the same months, from −1 to 1.
measures_correlation_too_few_notice: This stock, each stock in your portfolio, and the {index} share {returns} in the latest {window} complete months, but Portolab computes correlation only from at least {minimum}.
trading_average_cost_body: Average cost divides the cost of the shares you still hold, including purchase broker fees, by their share count.
trading_average_cost_calculation_notice: {cost} / {shares} = {average} per share, rounded to the nearest rupiah.
trading_position_gain_body: Unrealised profit or loss is the value of the shares at the delayed price less their purchase cost, including broker fees.
measures_correlation_prices_notice: Portfolio weights use delayed prices. Your portfolio page shows when each price was quoted.
measures_correlation_enough_returns_noti: If this stock, the {index}, and each of your stocks keep a close at the end of every month, Portolab computes correlation after the update of the price history that stores the close of the first trading day of {month}.
